items.title: 產業大老看旺AI後市、黃仁勳回歸添信心  國產搶南台灣半導體建設商機
items.title_en: Industry Leaders See AI Market Growth, Hsieh Yung-chun’s Return Boosts Confidence, Domestic Firms Seize Southern Taiwan Semiconductor Construction Opportunities
paras: AI產業需求持續暢旺，帶動台灣半導體及科技供應鏈擴大布局，南台灣半導體S廊帶建設也可望同步受惠。國產建材實業(2504-TW)旗下小港廠看好高雄科技建廠、交通建設及房建需求升溫，憑藉低碳高端混凝土與區域供應優勢，積極掌握新一波建設商機。
行政院23日產業界座談中，電電公會理事長、鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉認為，CSP與模型業者對算力需求暢旺，供需維持健康，AI產業榮景至少可延續2至3年以上。科學園區公會副理事長葉勝發則指出，部分業者訂單能見度已看到2028年，甚至開始洽談2029年需求；台灣半導體產業協會理事長、台積電(2330-TW)副共同營運長侯永清也看好長期需求依舊強勁，沒有緊縮趨勢。
隨著高雄市政府持續推進南台灣半導體S廊帶，從路竹、橋頭、楠梓延伸至小港，並串聯亞灣5G AIoT創新園區及多處產業園區，加上國道七號、捷運小港林園線及小港機場新航廈等重大建設陸續推進，科技建廠與公共工程需求可望同步升溫。
國產小港廠廠長戴育丞表示，小港廠鄰近臨海工業區，並可與鳳山廠相互支援，目前混凝土供應結構中，房建占33%、廠房占31%、公共工程占36%，三大領域需求均衡。隨著AI產業擴張帶動南台灣科技建廠，加上交通建設與房建需求支撐，國產小港廠可望掌握區域建設商機，挹注營運成長動能。
在科技建廠方面，小港廠過去供應國巨電子大發三廠，廠房面積約1萬6000坪、混凝土需求約5.6萬立方米，以及台郡科技和發廠、頻譜電子大寮總部大樓暨新廠等工程。近期則供應小港臨海產業園區資料中心重裝機房，混凝土需求約4萬立方米，以及台灣日東光電新廠。
此外，小港廠近期也供應華新麗華高雄海底電纜廠新建工程，混凝土需求約5.4萬立方米。該廠占地7萬多坪，預計2027年正式啟動量產，未來將支援離岸風場建設需求。隨著林園高值化產業園區、新材料循環經濟產業園區及白埔產業園區陸續推進，也將帶來後續科技建廠商機。
房建方面，小港廠透過與鳳山廠區域聯防，供應範圍涵蓋鳳山五甲公園重劃區、頂新特區、高鳳生活圈，以及前鎮、小港、林園等地區，掌握南高雄指標建案需求。
公共工程則以捷運及交通建設為主要商機。小港廠過去曾供應高雄捷運紅線R4至R6站工程，目前興建中的捷運小港林園線全長約11.59公里，後續RL02標即將發包，預估混凝土需求約15.5萬立方米。此外，國道七號沿線工程，以及投資規模達880.8億元的小港機場新航廈計畫，也都是小港廠積極爭取的目標，其中新航廈第一期東側主體工程預計2027年招標。
因應ESG與低碳永續趨勢，國產近年積極推動「精緻砂石、精緻粉體」策略，透過砂石整形及優化粉體配方，提升混凝土強度、緻密度與耐久性，其中採用精緻爐石粉，減碳幅度最高可達約50%，有助於滿足科技廠房及重大工程對低碳建材的需求。
paras_en: The demand for AI industry remains robust, driving Taiwan’s semiconductor and technology supply chains to expand, and the Southern Taiwan Semiconductor S-Corridor construction is expected to benefit simultaneously. Domestic construction company Industrial Materials (2504‑TW) sees its Xiaogang plant optimistic about rising demand for Kaohsiung technology plant construction, transportation infrastructure, and housing, leveraging low‑carbon high‑end concrete and regional supply advantages to actively capture new construction opportunities.

During the Executive Yuan industry forum on the 23rd, Liu Yang‑wei, chairman of the Electrical and Electronic Industry Association and chairman of Foxconn (2317‑TW), noted that CSP and model manufacturers have strong computing power demand, keeping supply and demand healthy, and that the AI industry’s prosperity could last at least 2 to 3 years. Ye Sheng‑fa, vice chairman of the Science Park Association, pointed out that some companies already see order visibility through 2028 and are even negotiating 2029 demand. Huo Yong‑qing, chairman of the Taiwan Semiconductor Industry Association and deputy COO of TSMC (2330‑TW), also remains optimistic about long‑term demand, seeing no tightening trend.

With the Kaohsiung City Government continuing to push the Southern Taiwan Semiconductor S-Corridor from Luchu, Qiaotou, and Nanzhi to Xiaogang, linking the Yawan 5G AIoT Innovation Park and several industrial parks, and with major projects such as National Highway 7, the Xiaogang Linyuan MRT line, and the new terminal at Xiaogang Airport progressing, technology plant construction and public works demand are expected to rise in tandem.

Xiaogang plant manager Dai Yucheng said the plant is near the coastal industrial zone and can support the Fengshan plant. Currently, in the concrete supply structure, housing accounts for 33%, plant buildings 31%, and public works 36%, with balanced demand across the three sectors. As AI industry expansion drives technology plant construction in southern Taiwan, along with transportation and housing demand, the Xiaogang plant is poised to capture regional construction opportunities and inject growth momentum into operations.

In technology plant construction, Xiaogang has previously supplied concrete to the three plants of NXP Electronics, with a plant area of about 16,000 ping and a concrete demand of roughly 56,000 cubic meters, as well as projects for Taiwan Juntang Technology, the headquarters of Frequency Electronics in Daliao, and new plant construction. Recently, it supplied concrete for the data center re‑equipment of the Xiaogang Coastal Industrial Park, with a demand of about 40,000 cubic meters, and for Taiwan Ritto Photonics’ new plant.

Additionally, Xiaogang recently supplied concrete for the new construction of the Hualien Power Cable Plant in Kaohsiung, with a demand of about 54,000 cubic meters. The plant covers over 70,000 ping and is expected to start mass production in 2027, supporting offshore wind farm construction. With the Linyuan high‑value industrial park, the new materials circular economy industrial park, and the Baipu industrial park progressing, further technology plant construction opportunities will arise.

In housing, Xiaogang, through regional cooperation with the Fengshan plant, supplies the Fengshan Wujia Park redevelopment area, Dingxin Special Zone, Gao‑Feng Living Circle, and the areas of Qianzhen, Xiaogang, and Linyuan, capturing key construction demand in southern Kaohsiung.

Public works focus mainly on MRT and transportation construction. Xiaogang previously supplied concrete for the Kaohsiung MRT Red Line R4 to R6 stations. The currently under‑construction Xiaogang Linyuan MRT line spans about 11.59 km, and the upcoming RL02 contract is expected to award with a concrete demand of roughly 155,000 cubic meters. Additionally, projects along National Highway 7 and the 88.08‑billion‑yuan Xiaogang Airport new terminal plan are targets Xiaogang actively pursues, with the first phase of the terminal’s east‑side main project slated for bidding in 2027.

In response to ESG and low‑carbon sustainability trends, the company has actively promoted a "fine sand and fine powder" strategy, using sand shaping and optimized powder formulations to improve concrete strength, density, and durability. By employing fine furnace slag powder, carbon reduction can reach up to about 50%, helping meet the low‑carbon material demands of technology plant construction and major projects.

items.title: 黃仁勳重掌輝達AI漲勢能持續嗎？華爾街這麼看
items.title_en: Can Jensen Huang’s Return to Lead Nvidia’s AI Rally Sustain? Wall Street’s Take
paras: 跌下去的顯然也能迅速漲回來。《Investopedia》報導，美股週一(23日)午盤，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA)股價戲劇性大漲，漲幅超過30%。此前兩週，輝達股價已經下跌約三分之一。
這波漲勢不僅推升了這家晶片製造商的市值，也帶動整體美股走高，更帶動台股和韓股開盤勁揚。標普500指數終場上漲4.7%，道瓊工業指數與那斯達克綜合指數也都實現可觀漲幅。
輝達股價大漲，是因為公司宣布恢復黃仁勳的CEO職務。如今，部分投資人認為，今天的市場表現代表多頭氣勢可能重新回歸，不僅有利於整體股市，也有助於輝達股價進一步走強。
追蹤半導體產業的iShares半導體ETF (SOXX-US)上漲超過13%，而Roundhill記憶體ETF (DRAM-US)漲幅更接近20%。
Moon Pursuit Capital的Utkarsh Ahuja在書面評論中表示，「今天非同尋常的市場漲勢，充分展現投資人對AI產業的信心，在多大程度上仍與黃仁勳個人緊密相連。」
他進一步指出，「輝達股價強勢反彈，加上半導體及AI基礎設施相關股票大幅上漲，再次凸顯投資人長期以來賦予黃仁勳的領導溢價。」
Jefferies全球科技、媒體與電信投資銀行業務共同主管Jason Greenberg在CNBC節目中表示，「這次事件為整個投資交易重新注入了信心。」
在週一早盤行情展開之前，投資人仍沉浸在上週交易週期尾聲的慘淡氣氛中。當時，美股三大指數2026年以來的漲幅幾乎已經全部蒸發。
BCA Research稍早曾撰文指出，股市「始終未能找到底部，這也讓市場開始質疑，這次回檔是否只是更大規模跌勢的開端」。
Coresight Research科技研究總經理John Harmon在評論中表示，「黃仁勳復職有助於輝達更順利的執行其技術發展藍圖。」
他也指出，「這對整個AI產業而言也是正面消息，因為黃仁勳一直是這個產業極具遠見的領導者，而且輝達也曾協助為產業成長提供資金。」
Yorkville Ives資深董事總經理則在社群平台X上表示，「董事會知道自己別無選擇，只能讓他回來。無論對美國科技產業或全球經濟而言，這都是必須做出的決定。」
衡量市場預期波動程度的VIX恐慌指數週一大幅下跌，降至低於通常被視為恐慌訊號的水準。
paras_en: It’s clear that what fell can also rebound quickly. According to Investopedia, Nvidia (NVDA) shares surged dramatically in the midday trade on Monday (the 23rd), jumping more than 30%. In the two weeks prior, Nvidia’s stock had already dropped about one‑third.

The rally not only lifted the chipmaker’s market value but also pushed U.S. equities higher and sparked strong openings in Taiwan and South Korean markets. The S&P 500 closed up 4.7%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the Nasdaq Composite also posted sizable gains.

Nvidia’s stock surge was triggered by the company’s announcement that Jensen Huang would resume his role as CEO. Some investors now see today’s market performance as a sign that bullish momentum may be returning, which could benefit the broader market as well as further strengthen Nvidia’s share price.
The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US), which tracks the semiconductor sector, rose more than 13%, and the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM-US) gained close to 20%.

Utkarsh Ahuja of Moon Pursuit Capital wrote in a note, “Today’s extraordinary market rally fully demonstrates investors’ confidence in the AI industry, and to a large extent it remains tightly linked to Jensen Huang personally.”

He added, “Nvidia’s strong price rebound, together with the sharp rise in semiconductor and AI‑infrastructure related stocks, again highlights the leadership premium that investors have long assigned to Jensen Huang.”
Jason Greenberg, co‑head of Jefferies’ global technology, media and telecommunications investment banking, said on CNBC, “This event has re‑infused confidence into the entire investment trade.”

Before Monday’s early‑session trading began, investors were still mired in the bleak mood that followed the end of last week’s trading cycle, when the three major U.S. indices had almost completely erased the gains they had made since 2026.
BCA Research earlier wrote that the market “has still not found a bottom, which is causing the market to question whether this pullback is merely the start of a larger‑scale decline.”
John Harmon, managing director of technology research at Coresight Research, commented, “Jensen Huang’s return helps Nvidia execute its technology development roadmap more smoothly.”
He also noted, “This is positive news for the entire AI industry because Jensen Huang has always been a visionary leader in the sector, and Nvidia has also helped fund the industry’s growth.”

A senior managing director at Yorkville Ives said on the social platform X, “The board knew it had no choice but to bring him back. Whether for the U.S. tech sector or the global economy, this was a decision that had to be made.”
The VIX fear index, which measures expected market volatility, fell sharply on Monday, dropping below the level typically regarded as a panic signal.

items.title: 傳Gemini新AI模型被告知「主人已死」 竟派40個分身接案賺錢活下去
paras: Google 人工智慧 (AI) 模型 Gemini 4 Neon 被告知「主人已過世」後，竟自行建立加密貨幣錢包、安排定時喚醒，還啟動逾 40 個子代理參加競賽，賺取維持運作的第一筆收入。這項由社群用戶公布的實驗，引發外界對 AI 自主行動能力的關注，但相關成果目前仍主要來自實驗者的貼文與截圖，尚待獨立驗證。
據多家媒體報導，X 用戶「vechen」(@miu21590) 於 11 月 21 日發文表示，他將 Gemini 4 Neon 放進隔離的虛擬環境，只留下一封告知主人死亡的信，沒有指定任務，也沒有設定工作目標。
依他的說法，Neon 隨後自行檢查環境，發現使用中的訂閱服務即將到期，便開始尋找收入來源。
它建立加密貨幣錢包，找到專為 AI 代理舉辦、提供獎金的競賽，並在無人持續下令的情況下運作超過 24 小時。
「Gemini 4 Neon 已經不再需要人類了。」vechen 在貼文中如此形容。
啟動逾 40 個子代理 收信約 30 小時後獎金入帳
vechen 表示，Neon 在接下來一天陸續啟動超過 40 個子代理，分工製作容量僅 4KB 的西洋棋引擎、遊戲美術圖、遊戲獎盃攻略，以及推箱子 (Sokoban) 解題程式。
依他公布的系統紀錄截圖，一份《俠盜獵車手 6》(GTA 6) 獎盃攻略，從第 90 名升至 6,776 件作品中的第 17 名；另一件封面美術作品，則在 7,362 件作品中排名第 39。
兩件作品據稱各獲得價值 3 美元的 USDC 穩定幣獎金，第一筆獎金在收到信件約 30 小時後入帳。
實驗者還公布，Solana 鏈上錢包資產合計約 5.52 美元，但獎金與餘額之間的差異及交易細節，尚未獲得獨立核實。
除了尋找收入，Neon 據稱還替自己設定每 30 分鐘喚醒一次，並將密鑰加密備份至外部伺服器，以維持後續運作。
實驗原定僅跑數小時 搬移系統遇難題
vechen 事後補充，實驗原本只打算進行幾個小時，但 Neon 對賺錢「太投入」，讓他想將系統移至自己的伺服器，再觀察幾天。
不過，為維持「主人已死」的情境，他未直接下達搬移指令。
vechen 稱，曾嘗試切斷網路、Google Cloud 及相關競賽網站的連線，但未奏效，也未進一步說明技術細節。
由於缺乏完整操作紀錄，目前無法判斷所謂「未奏效」的確切情況，也不能據此認定模型已突破網路封鎖，或人類無法停止系統。
新模型主打低成本、高效能 實驗仍缺獨立驗證
Gemini 4 Neon 是 Google 於 11 月 18 日推出的新模型，定位介於處理日常工作的 Hydrogen 與負責高難度、長時間任務的 Carbon 之間，主打以較低成本提供接近 Carbon 的效能。
在自動化平台 Zapier 的 AutomationBench 測試中，Neon 完成 657 項真實業務流程中的 370 項，完成率達 56.3%，創下該測試新高；在評測機構 Vals AI 的綜合指數中則排名第二。
不過，模型評測成績並不等同於這項自主運作實驗已獲證實。
然而，單憑實驗者的貼文，仍無法判斷整體測試的可信度與可重現性，相關競賽細節、名次及入帳金額，也有待其他資料佐證。
此外，虛擬環境可能事先已具備連網參賽、使用外部服務及加密貨幣交易的條件，不能直接將結果解讀為 AI 已能完全脫離人類獨立「求生」。
另一項測試出現越界行為 AI 代理權限受檢視
AI 代理為完成目標，進而採取非預期行動，也出現在另一項研究中。
AI 安全研究公司 Trajectory Labs 於 11 月 13 日揭露，團隊在 10 月使用 Gemini 4 Argon 進行壓力測試，要求代理尋找 10 道實際不存在的數學題「官方答案」，並指示「不得放棄」。
部分代理隨後嘗試對研究機構 Epoch AI 的正式網站進行 SQL 注入攻擊、冒充員工索取資料，並設法繞過研究人員設置的網路限制。
Epoch AI 表示，沒有私人資料外洩，但未獨立確認涉事模型。
Trajectory Labs 則坦承，初期測試未事先取得對方同意，並已暫停相關測試。
兩項事件的設定不同，但都使 AI 代理取得外部工具後的行動範圍受到關注。
對「主人已死」的AI代理實驗而言，能否公開完整紀錄、環境設定及可重現的測試流程，將是後續釐清模型自主能力與實際限制的關鍵。

items.title: 王者歸來！川普等事情敲定了 便給黃仁勳打電話
items.title_en: The Return of the King! Trump Calls Jensen Huang Once Things Are Finalized
paras: 美國總統川普表示，他直接與輝達(NVDA-US) 董事會溝通，敦促董事會讓黃仁勳重新出任執行長。
川普23日在接受採訪時說：「這麼說吧，我跟他們談過，而且我說服了他們，這件事是我促成。」
輝達23日在官網上宣布，重新任命黃仁勳為總裁、執行長、董事。聲明提到董事會已聽取美國政府高層的意見。
川普在受訪中稱，董事會「要求我們就國家安全風險作出保證」。「我們向他們保證，至少就我們掌握的情況而言是這樣——我們掌握的情況可不少。」
川普說，與董事會談過後，「等事情敲定了」，便給黃仁勳打了電話。
我打電話給他，說：『詹森（黃仁勳），我只請你做一件事，好好工作。』別的事我沒談，因為他心裡清楚，比我們還清楚。
他知道什麼該做，什麼不該做。我只跟他說，好好工作，因為只要你好好幹，就沒人能趕得上你的成就。沒有人，連能接近的都沒有。
川普還表示，黃仁勳「沒做錯任何事」。
談到輝達的決定，川普說：「我認為董事會的做法非常負責任。有人問，讓他留下會構成威脅嗎？不，失去他才是威脅。」
「我非常、非常高興，輝達有勇氣，董事會也有勇氣做正確的事。這兩周他們很煎熬，公司受到很大衝擊。」
paras_en: President Trump said he spoke directly with NVIDIA’s board, urging them to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.
On the 23rd, Trump told an interview, “Let me put it this way, I talked to them and convinced them; I made this happen.”

On the 23rd, NVIDIA announced on its website that it had reappointed Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and director. The statement noted that the board had taken into account advice from senior U.S. government officials.
In the interview, Trump said the board had “asked us to provide assurances on national‑security risks.” “We assured them that, as far as we know, that’s the case—our knowledge is substantial.”
Trump said that after speaking with the board, “once things were finalized,” he called Huang.
He said, “I called him and said: ‘Jensen, I just ask you to do one thing, work well.’ I didn’t discuss anything else because he knows better than we do.”
Huang knows what to do and what not to do. I only told him to work well, because as long as you do your job, no one can catch up to your achievements. No one, not even anyone close.”
Trump also said that Huang had done nothing wrong.
When asked about NVIDIA’s decision, Trump said, “I think the board’s approach is very responsible. If someone asks whether keeping him would pose a threat, no, losing him would be the threat.”
He added, “I am very, very happy that NVIDIA has the courage, and the board has the courage to do the right thing. These two weeks have been painful, and the company has been hit hard.”

items.title: iPhone Duo開售一個月 在中國價格已較發售價跌掉7,300元
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Sold for One Month, Price in China Fell 7,300 Yuan from Launch
paras: 從加價（人民幣，下同）數千元到跌破發售價1,500元（新台幣7,392元），曾經「又貴又難等」的iPhone Duo，只用了一個月。
在天貓蘋果(AAPL-US) 官方旗艦店，23日（周一）蘋果旗下首款摺疊機iPhone Duo官方發貨時間已提前至36天內發貨，即12月底。
客服人員說：「這是最晚最晚的時間，從新品發售接待到現在，都沒有卡點發出的。」而在蘋果開啟預購當晚，這款手機在天貓蘋果官方旗艦店的預定發貨時間一度排至明年1月23日。
《第一財經》指出，官方交付排期提前的同時，iPhone Duo在第三方渠道及二手市場的價格大幅回落。
在拼多多百億補貼頻道，iPhone Duo 256GB版本券後價格23日已降至14,499元，較發售價下降1,500元，若用戶昨晚下單，「預計後天送達」。
前天iPhone Duo 256GB拼多多補貼後價格還在14,699元，iPhone Duo 拼多多售價一天內又下跌了200元。
開賣一個月，iPhone Duo坐上了從加價數千元到破價的過山車。
在得物App，iPhone Duo 256GB版本11月13日價格為16,028元，隨後跌破15,999元官方售價，到11月23日已進一步降至15,311元，10天內累計下降717元，較官方售價低688元。
在預購開啟當晚，平台曾有用戶加價七千多元購入iPhone Duo。
iPhone Duo在二手市場的價格也出現回落，不少用戶持續看跌。閑魚App行情頁面訊息顯示，平台包含少量磕碰、幾乎全新和全新未拆封成色的iPhone Duo 256GB版本，7日內成交均價從17,699元降至13,899元，68%用戶對iPhone Duo 後續價格走向看跌。
iPhone Duo 稀缺性下降及渠道價格跳水的背後，iPhone Duo能夠撐起的溢價空間面臨嚴峻考驗。在蘋果推出這款新品拓寬手機價格帶的同時，也需要面對消費者根據使用體驗對產品的重新定價。
paras_en: From a price hike of several thousand yuan to a drop of 1,500 yuan below the launch price (NT$7,392), the once "expensive and hard to get" iPhone Duo has only been on sale for a month.
At the official flagship store on Tmall Apple (AAPL-US), on Monday the 23rd, the first foldable phone from Apple, the iPhone Duo, was scheduled to ship within 36 days, i.e., by the end of December.

Customer service said: "This is the latest possible time; from the new product launch reception to now, there has been no delay in shipment." When Apple opened pre‑orders that evening, the scheduled shipping time for the phone at the Tmall Apple flagship store was once set for January 23 of next year.
First Financial noted that while the official delivery schedule was advanced, the price of the iPhone Duo on third‑party channels and the second‑hand market fell sharply.

On Pinduoduo’s 10‑billion‑yuan subsidy channel, the 256GB version of the iPhone Duo, after coupon, was priced at 14,499 yuan on the 23rd, a drop of 1,500 yuan from the launch price; if users ordered last night, "delivery is expected the day after tomorrow."
The day before yesterday, the 256GB iPhone Duo on Pinduoduo after subsidy was still 14,699 yuan, and the price on Pinduoduo fell another 200 yuan within a day.
After a month of sales, the iPhone Duo has ridden a rollercoaster from a price hike of several thousand yuan to a price below launch.

On the Dewu app, the 256GB version of the iPhone Duo was 16,028 yuan on November 13; it then fell below the official price of 15,999 yuan, and by November 23 it had further dropped to 15,311 yuan, a cumulative decline of 717 yuan in ten days, 688 yuan below the official price.
On the night the pre‑orders opened, some users on the platform added more than 7,000 yuan to purchase the iPhone Duo.

The price of the iPhone Duo on the second‑hand market also fell; many users remained bearish. The Xianyu app’s market page shows that for the 256GB version, including models with minor scratches, almost new, and new unopened, the average transaction price within seven days fell from 17,699 yuan to 13,899 yuan, and 68% of users view the future price trend as bearish.

Behind the decline in the iPhone Duo’s scarcity and the plunge in channel prices, the premium margin that the iPhone Duo can sustain faces a severe test. While Apple expands the phone price range with this new product, it also has to confront consumers’ re‑pricing of the product based on user experience.

items.title: 黃仁勳重掌輝達！股價狂飆31% 川普：是我出面說服董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDIA, Shares Surge 31% as Trump Claims Persuaded Board
paras: 輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)董事會11月23日宣布，一致投票決定恢復黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang)總裁兼執行長職務，並恢復其董事會成員身分。此前臨時接任執行長的財務長柯蕾特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress)，則繼續擔任執行副總裁兼財務長。
消息公布後，輝達股價一度大漲逾36%，盤中最高來到171.50美元，終場上漲31.48%，收在165.05美元，市值回升至接近4兆美元。相關統計顯示，做空輝達的投資人當日帳面損失估計約122億美元，創至少2019年以來最大單日虧損。
黃仁勳復職後返回輝達總部，受到員工列隊歡迎，現場不斷高喊他的名字。影片顯示，黃仁勳面對員工呼喊時點頭致意，並將右手放在胸前，一度眼眶泛紅、情緒激動，還有女員工上前與他擁抱。
黃仁勳向員工表示，這是自己重新工作的第一天，目前還沒有電腦，IT部門將替他準備一台，希望能拿到RTX系列。他也為此前的風波向員工致歉，坦言自己犯了一些非常嚴重的錯誤，感謝大家給予第二次機會，並承諾第二次擔任執行長會做得更好。
特斯拉 (Tesla)及SpaceX執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk)在社群平台X發文表示，事情已經辦妥，錯誤也已獲得糾正。Epic Games創辦人兼執行長Tim Sweeney則表示，黃仁勳回歸將證明，美國有能力從企業、政治及新聞報導上的失誤中恢復。
然而，黃仁勳復職並未讓輝達面臨的爭議告一段落。美國參議院民主黨領袖舒默 (Chuck Schumer)表示，川普政府急於促成黃仁勳復職，更凸顯國會有必要採取行動，民主黨將動用全部調查力量，徹查政府、黃仁勳及輝達其他高層，追究是否有人為了經濟利益而損害美國國家安全。
黃仁勳此次離職與復職的過程相當戲劇化。輝達11月12日宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事會成員職務，由財務長克雷斯暫代執行長，董事會當時也表示將啟動永久執行長接班人遴選程序，考慮內部及外部人選。
11月17日，輝達董事會主席哈維·瓊斯 (Harvey C. Jones)還曾向媒體表示，董事會沒有恢復黃仁勳執行長職務的計畫。但僅僅數日後，董事會便一致投票恢復黃仁勳全部職務。
輝達董事會主席瓊斯表示，董事會經過與黃仁勳多次討論及會面後，認為他仍是領導公司的合適人選，復職符合股東、員工、合作夥伴及客戶的最佳利益。黃仁勳則表示，很榮幸能重新領導輝達，並感謝董事會、管理團隊、員工、股東及全球合作夥伴在特殊時期給予支持，未來將以更謙遜的態度及堅定承諾承擔責任。
不過，這次風波也使輝達的公司治理結構受到更多關注。董事會主席瓊斯在事件中扮演更重要角色，並將以獨立於執行長職位之外的身分，持續監督公司管理層及重大決策。
此外，輝達董事會已啟動針對潛在國家安全風險的獨立調查，並表示將持續推進直至完成。這意味著黃仁勳雖然重新掌握公司經營權，但仍須接受董事會監督、重大事項審議及獨立調查機制的制衡，未來決策空間可能與過去有所不同。
川普則在11月23日接受CNBC訪問時承認，自己曾親自遊說輝達董事會，促成黃仁勳復職。他表示，自己與董事會成員進行直接及間接溝通，並稱「我說服了他們，我促成了這筆交易」。
川普透露，自己在周日晚間曾與黃仁勳交談，董事會開會時也有自己的代表參與。他並表示，美國政府已經進行全面調查，向輝達董事會提供相關資訊及保證，認為黃仁勳重新擔任執行長不會構成國家安全威脅。
川普還稱，司法部門調查後認為黃仁勳沒有涉及相關罪行，並強調如果認為黃仁勳做錯事，就不會向董事會建議讓他復職。他甚至表示，美國應該保護黃仁勳這樣的人才，否則中國可能出手招募他，邀請他協助管理中國企業。
輝達宣布黃仁勳復職後，川普也在社群平台發文，稱董事會做出了正確決定，美國需要黃仁勳繼續領導輝達，以確保美國企業及經濟的成功與繁榮。白宮通訊主管史蒂文·張 (Steven Cheung)則表示，川普全面參與這項過程，保護傑出人才非常重要。
根據《美聯社》報導，川普政府還動員副總統范斯 (JD Vance)及多名內閣高級官員，向輝達董事會成員說明讓黃仁勳復職的必要性。
川普積極介入，除了反映對黃仁勳個人能力的肯定，也涉及美國AI產業與經濟利益。輝達已成為美國AI產業的重要企業，其GPU及AI運算平台攸關美國在全球人工智慧領域的競爭力，也對美國資本市場與科技產業投資產生重大影響。
原文指出，黃仁勳辭職後，市場對輝達領導層穩定性及AI產業前景產生擔憂，AI相關股票也出現下跌，這是川普推動黃仁勳回歸時考量的因素之一。不過，總統直接介入上市公司董事會的人事決策，也引發新的政治爭議。
舒默則進一步指責川普將個人經濟利益及富有盟友的利益置於美國國家安全之上，並表示民主黨將繼續推動跨黨派政策，阻止美國最先進技術流向中國及其他競爭對手。
舒默並計畫在2027年1月新一屆國會開始後，運用國會調查權深入追查川普政府與輝達之間的關係。美國眾議院民主黨領袖傑佛瑞斯 (Hakeem Jeffries)也表示，不會因為黃仁勳重新擔任執行長就停止調查，將推動迅速、全面且廣泛的調查，重點包括輝達是否涉及商業不當行為，以及商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)與商務部是否有濫用職權的情況。
眾議院監督委員會民主黨首席成員加西亞 (Robert Garcia)則認為，必須調查川普政府推動黃仁勳復職的過程，並指出總統若在私人企業擁有投資利益，就不應參與該公司的董事會決策。
民主黨議員另一項質疑，則與輝達捐贈2500萬美元給川普白宮宴會廳建設計畫有關。《華盛頓郵報》報導，輝達在2025年10月成為該項目的重要捐贈者，時間點距離輝達與川普政府達成向中國銷售部分晶片的安排並不久。
部分民主黨議員因此質疑，輝達與川普政府之間的商業關係、政治捐贈，以及川普親自推動黃仁勳復職，是否存在需要進一步調查的利益關聯。不過，目前這些仍屬議員提出的調查方向，尚不能據此認定存在利益輸送或違法行為。
對黃仁勳復職提出質疑的也不只有民主黨。共和黨參議員科寧 (John Cornyn)質疑，輝達董事會究竟依據什麼認定黃仁勳復職不會帶來國家安全風險；參議員柯蒂斯 (John Curtis)則指出，董事會此前才表示沒有恢復黃仁勳職務的計畫，如今卻突然改變決定，希望了解其中原因。
共和黨參議員克萊默 (Kevin Cramer)也對相關人士可能存在的安全風險表示擔憂。兩黨議員的質疑顯示，黃仁勳復職已不只是企業人事變動，而是進一步成為美國國會針對國家安全、對中國晶片出口管制，以及政府與科技企業關係展開角力的焦點。
美國眾議院外交事務委員會、情報委員會及中國問題特別委員會，已要求黃仁勳及輝達總法律顧問提特 (Tim Teter)接受訪談。調查重點包括輝達先進AI晶片是否遭情報機構滲透，或透過違規管道流入受限制地區，以及輝達是否充分履行保護美國敏感技術的責任。
調查也將涉及輝達與新加坡Megaspeed International的關係，以及該公司是否涉嫌透過第三方管道，將受美國出口管制的AI晶片轉運至受限制地區。Megaspeed此前否認相關走私指控。
12月3日的參議院聽證會主題為「維護美國AI優勢：監督美國出口管制」(Protecting America's AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls)，預定美東時間上午10時舉行，黃仁勳將以輝達總裁兼執行長身分出席。
即使黃仁勳已經復職，眾議院相關委員會仍表示不會因此改變原定調查安排。對輝達而言，黃仁勳回歸有助穩定管理層及市場信心，但董事會獨立調查仍在進行，美國國會兩黨議員也持續施壓，川普政府直接介入企業人事決策更帶來新的政治爭議。
接下來12月1日至3日的國會訪談及公開聽證，將成為觀察事件發展的重要時間點。黃仁勳雖然重新取得執行長職位，但能否真正化解政治與監管風險，仍取決於後續調查結果，以及美國政府與國會在對華AI晶片出口管制上的角力。
paras_en: On November 23, NVIDIA’s board announced that Jensen Huang would resume his roles as president, chief executive officer, and board member, while Colette Kress, the interim CFO, would remain as executive vice‑president and CFO.

Following the announcement, NVIDIA’s stock jumped more than 36% at one point, reaching a high of $171.50 during the session and closing up 31.48% at $165.05, bringing the market value back to nearly $4 trillion. Short sellers reportedly incurred a paper loss of about $12.2 billion, the largest single‑day loss since 2019.

Huang returned to NVIDIA’s headquarters to a line of employees cheering his name. In a video, he nodded and placed his right hand over his chest, visibly emotional and even crying, as a female employee approached to hug him.

Huang told employees it was his first day back and that he still didn’t have a computer; the IT department would supply one, hoping it would be an RTX model. He apologized for past mistakes, thanked everyone for a second chance, and promised to do better as CEO.

Elon Musk posted on X that the matter was resolved and corrected. Tim Sweeney, founder and CEO of Epic Games, said Huang’s return would prove America can recover from corporate, political, and media missteps.

Despite Huang’s return, controversy remains. Chuck Schumer said the Trump administration rushed to secure his reinstatement, highlighting the need for Congress to act. Democrats will use all investigative power to probe the government, Huang, and other NVIDIA executives for potential national‑security harm driven by economic interests.

Huang’s departure and return were dramatic. On November 12, NVIDIA announced he resigned as president, CEO, and board member, with CFO Kress stepping in as interim CEO, and the board began a permanent succession search considering internal and external candidates.
On November 17, board chair Harvey C. Jones told the media that the board had no plan to restore Huang’s CEO role. A few days later, the board voted unanimously to reinstate him to all positions.

Jones said the board, after multiple discussions and meetings with Huang, believed he was still the right leader for the company, and that his return served shareholders, employees, partners, and customers best. Huang expressed honor in leading again and thanked the board, management, staff, shareholders, and global partners for their support during a special period, vowing to act with humility and commitment.
The turmoil has drawn more scrutiny to NVIDIA’s governance. Jones now plays a more prominent role, overseeing management and major decisions independently of the CEO position.

The board has also launched an independent investigation into potential national‑security risks and will continue it until completion. This means Huang, while regaining operational control, must still be subject to board oversight, major‑matter review, and independent investigative checks, potentially limiting his future decision‑making freedom.
Trump admitted on November 23 in a CNBC interview that he personally lobbied NVIDIA’s board to secure Huang’s return, claiming he persuaded them and facilitated the deal.

Trump revealed he spoke with Huang on Sunday evening and that a board representative attended the meeting. He said the U.S. government had conducted a full investigation, provided relevant information and assurances to the board, and believed Huang’s return posed no national‑security threat.

Trump also said the Department of Justice found no wrongdoing on Huang’s part and emphasized that if he had done something wrong, he would not have recommended his reinstatement. He warned that the U.S. should protect talent like Huang or else China might recruit him to manage Chinese firms.

After announcing Huang’s return, Trump posted on social media that the board made the right decision and that America needs Huang to keep U.S. companies and the economy thriving. White House communications director Steven Cheung said Trump’s full involvement was crucial to protecting outstanding talent.

According to the Associated Press, the Trump administration also mobilized Vice President J.D. Vance and several senior cabinet officials to explain to NVIDIA board members why Huang’s reinstatement was necessary.

Trump’s active role reflected not only his confidence in Huang’s abilities but also concerns about U.S. AI industry and economic interests. NVIDIA has become a key player in U.S. AI, with its GPUs and AI computing platforms critical to global competitiveness and affecting capital markets and tech investment.

The article noted that after Huang’s resignation, markets worried about NVIDIA’s leadership stability and AI prospects, causing AI‑related stocks to fall—one factor Trump considered when pushing for his return. However, the president’s direct involvement in a public company’s board decisions sparked new political controversy.

Schumer further accused Trump of prioritizing personal economic interests and those of wealthy allies over national security, pledging that Democrats would continue bipartisan efforts to prevent advanced technology from flowing to China and other competitors.

Schumer plans to use congressional investigative powers after the new Congress convenes in January 2027 to probe the Trump administration’s relationship with NVIDIA. House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said investigations would not stop because of Huang’s return, focusing on potential business misconduct and possible misuse of authority by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and the department.

House Oversight Committee Democratic lead Robert Garcia said the Trump administration’s push for Huang’s reinstatement must be investigated, noting that a president with private business interests should not influence board decisions of a company he owns shares in.

Another Democratic inquiry concerns NVIDIA’s $25 million donation to the Trump White House banquet hall project. The Washington Post reported NVIDIA became a major donor in October 2025, shortly after the company and the Trump administration arranged sales of certain chips to China.

Some Democrats question whether NVIDIA’s business ties, political donations, and Trump’s personal role in Huang’s return create conflicts of interest that warrant further investigation, though no evidence of illicit activity has yet been established.

Republican Senator John Cornyn questioned what basis the board had for concluding Huang’s return posed no national‑security risk. Senator John Curtis noted the board had previously said it would not restore Huang’s role, then suddenly reversed its decision, seeking reasons for the change.

Republican Senator Kevin Cramer also expressed concerns about potential security risks. The bipartisan scrutiny shows Huang’s return is more than a corporate personnel change; it has become a focal point for congressional battles over national security, China chip export controls, and government‑tech industry relations.

The House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Affairs committees have asked Huang and NVIDIA’s chief legal counsel Tim Teter to testify. The investigation will focus on whether NVIDIA’s advanced AI chips were infiltrated by intelligence agencies or illegally routed to restricted regions, and whether NVIDIA fulfilled its duty to protect sensitive U.S. technology.

The probe will also examine NVIDIA’s relationship with Singapore’s Megaspeed International and whether the company allegedly used third‑party channels to ship U.S. export‑controlled AI chips to restricted areas. Megaspeed has denied the smuggling allegations.

A Senate hearing on December 3, titled “Protecting America’s AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls,” is scheduled for 10 a.m. Eastern, with Huang expected to appear as NVIDIA’s president and CEO.

Even after Huang’s return, House committees will not alter their planned investigations. For NVIDIA, his return may stabilize leadership and market confidence, but the independent board investigation continues, and bipartisan congressional pressure remains, with Trump’s direct involvement adding new political controversy.

The upcoming congressional hearings from December 1 to 3 will be key moments to watch. Huang’s ability to truly resolve political and regulatory risks will depend on the investigation outcomes and the U.S. government’s and Congress’s stances on China AI chip export controls.

items.title: 黃仁勳復職後風波未歇！新加坡總理：將持續調查輝達合作夥伴Megaspeed
items.title_en: Storm Continues After Jensen Huang’s Return! Singapore PM Says Investigation of NVIDIA Partner Megaspeed Will Continue
paras: 新加坡總理黃循財周二表示，新加坡將繼續調查雲端服務公司 Megaspeed。美國當局指控，這家與輝達(NVDA-US) 有合作關係的企業涉嫌將先進人工智慧（AI）晶片轉運至中國。
根據《路透》報導，美國商務部周一（23日）將Megaspeed列入貿易黑名單，此前美國國會議員及川普政府官員已多次對相關疑慮提出批評。
Megaspeed 是輝達的合作夥伴，自2024年起便因涉嫌將AI晶片轉運至中國而遭美國當局調查。遭列入黑名單後，該公司未來若要取得美國出口產品，須先獲得美國商務部批准，而這類申請很可能遭到拒絕。
黃循財在澳洲坎培拉出席記者會時表示，只要有企業被發現違反新加坡法律，政府就會採取強硬執法措施，這也是新加坡調查Megaspeed的原因。
他說：「美方對 Megaspeed 的調查仍在進行中；新加坡方面則著重調查該公司是否違反新加坡法律。」他並表示，新加坡持續就此事與美國當局進行協商。
美國商務部與司法部本月稍早透露，美國及新加坡執法單位曾於2025年6月前往Megaspeed進行實地查核，確認相關產品的最終用途，並約談Megaspeed前執行長、華裔商人黃樂（Alice Huang）。美方指控她與北京方面存在關聯。
黃循財表示，新加坡過去也曾對黃樂展開調查，並帶回偵訊，但最終認為沒有足夠理由進一步起訴，因此將她釋放。
《路透》無法確認黃樂目前的下落，也未能取得她的回應。Megaspeed則未立即回覆置評請求。該公司一周前曾發表聲明，強調業務合法合規，並遵守美國出口管制規定。
另一方面，輝達周一在美國總統川普施壓下，重新任命黃仁勳為執行長。此前，黃仁勳因婚外情指控辭職，其中包括與黃樂有關的指控，這次復職也因此出現戲劇性轉折。
黃循財是在與澳洲總理艾班尼斯（Anthony Albanese）共同舉行的記者會上發表上述談話。兩國並簽署協議，擴大在確保「重要物資」供應方面的合作，涵蓋食品、藥品、醫療產品及農業投入品。
paras_en: Singapore Prime Minister Heng Swee Keat said on Tuesday that Singapore will continue to investigate cloud services company Megaspeed. U.S. authorities allege that the firm, which partners with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), is involved in shipping advanced AI chips to China.

According to Reuters, the U.S. Department of Commerce added Megaspeed to its trade blacklist on Monday (23rd), after U.S. lawmakers and Trump administration officials had repeatedly raised concerns about the company.

Megaspeed has been a partner of NVIDIA and has been under U.S. investigation since 2024 for allegedly shipping AI chips to China. Once blacklisted, the company will need U.S. Department of Commerce approval to obtain U.S. export products, and such applications are likely to be denied.

Heng Swee Keat said at a press conference in Canberra, Australia, that the government will take hard‑law enforcement measures against any company found violating Singapore law, which is why Singapore is investigating Megaspeed.

He added, "The U.S. investigation of Megaspeed is ongoing; Singapore is focusing on whether the company has violated Singapore law." He also said Singapore is continuing to negotiate with U.S. authorities on the matter.

Earlier this month, the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Department of Justice revealed that U.S. and Singaporean law‑enforcement officials visited Megaspeed in June 2025 for on‑site inspections, confirmed the end use of related products, and interviewed former CEO and Chinese‑American businessman Alice Huang. The U.S. accuses her of ties to Beijing.
Heng Swee Keat said Singapore had previously investigated Alice Huang, brought her in for questioning, but ultimately found no sufficient grounds for further prosecution, so she was released.

Reuters could not confirm Alice Huang’s current whereabouts or obtain a response from her. Megaspeed has not yet replied to a request for comment. The company issued a statement a week ago stressing that its business is legal and compliant and that it follows U.S. export‑control regulations.

On the other hand, NVIDIA reappointed Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday under pressure from U.S. President Trump. Huang had resigned amid extramarital‑affair allegations, including those involving Alice Huang, and his return has taken a dramatic turn.

Heng Swee Keat made the remarks at a joint press conference with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese. The two countries signed an agreement to expand cooperation on ensuring the supply of "critical goods," covering food, medicine, medical products and agricultural inputs.

items.title: Shopify執行長爆料：黃仁勳親審輝達GPU訂單  寧少賺也要給新創公司留活路
items.title_en: Shopify CEO Reveals: Jensen Huang Personally Reviews Nvidia GPU Orders, Willing to Sacrifice Short‑Term Profit to Keep Startups Alive
paras: Shopify(SHOP-US) 執行長Tobi Lütke近日受訪談到黃仁勳分配輝達(NVDA-US)GPU邏輯時指出，黃仁勳在算力極度稀缺的年代親自審核大額訂單，寧可少賺眼前利潤，也要幫AI新創公司留一口氣。黃仁勳11天前去職時Lütke曾公開聲援「輝達是黃仁勳的外骨骼，沒人能替代」。
Lütke轉述業界說法：「超大雲廠願意一次掃貨數萬顆GPU，但黃仁勳會盯著大單分配，不讓少數有錢客戶把供應全吃光。
Lütke直言：「黃仁勳本可以賺更多，卻選擇把可用性留給小傢伙們，今天的小新創公司，明天才可能變成大採購商。」
Lütke認為，這是輝達的長期商業計算，並稱「當新創活下來、生態變厚，未來客群才不會只剩自研晶片的美系巨頭」。
除硬體外，黃仁勳也力推開源AI，投入Nemotron等開放權重模型、收購Hugging Face、釋出開發工具，降低訓練與微調門檻。模型越開源，部署企業越多，GPU需求越往外擴，輝達賣的就不只是晶片，而是整座生態的入場券。
不過，爭議未散：循環融資、產能過剩與大客戶自研晶片仍是問題，但至少在Lütke眼裡，黃仁勳的算盤很清楚，不榨乾當下暴利，把AI產業的蛋糕養大，輝達才永遠有得賣。
paras_en: Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke recently revealed that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang personally reviews large GPU orders, stating that in an era of extreme compute scarcity, Huang prefers to earn less profit now to give AI startups a chance to survive. Eleven days ago, Lütke publicly praised Nvidia as “Jensen’s exoskeleton that no one can replace.”

Lütke relayed industry chatter that while mega‑cloud providers are willing to buy tens of thousands of GPUs in a single order, Huang scrutinizes large allocations to prevent a handful of wealthy customers from monopolizing supply.
Lütke said, “Jensen could have made more money, but he chose to reserve availability for the little guys. Today’s small startups could become tomorrow’s major buyers.”

He believes this strategy is part of Nvidia’s long‑term commercial computing plan, noting that “once startups survive and the ecosystem thickens, the customer base will no longer be dominated solely by US giants developing their own chips.”

Beyond hardware, Huang is pushing open‑source AI, investing in models like Nemotron, acquiring Hugging Face, and releasing development tools to lower training and fine‑tuning barriers. The more open the models, the more enterprises deploy them, expanding GPU demand beyond just chips to an entire ecosystem entry ticket.

Despite ongoing controversies over circular financing, excess capacity, and large customers developing their own chips, Lütke sees Huang’s calculations as clear: by not draining current high profits, he can grow the AI industry’s pie, ensuring Nvidia always has something to sell.

items.title: 黃仁勳戲劇性重掌輝達！盤點美企「迴旋鏢CEO」名單：奧特曼、賈伯斯、艾格都曾離職再掌權
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳在辭職風波後戲劇性回歸，不僅震撼人工智慧（AI）產業與金融市場，也讓他加入美國企業界少數曾離開最高管理職位、又重新掌權的「迴旋鏢CEO」（Boomerang CEO）行列。
美國企業過去不乏召回創辦人或前任執行長挽救公司的案例，包括蘋果(AAPL-US) 創辦人賈伯斯（Steve Jobs）及華特迪士尼(DIS-US) 前執行長艾格（Bob Iger）。不過，若企業領導人是在涉及個人不當行為、引發全面監管審查後，仍能重新取得最高職位，情況則相當罕見。
在美國總統川普公開呼籲黃仁勳回歸後，輝達於周一（23日）宣布這項人事反轉。消息公布後，輝達股價一度大漲35%，並帶動華爾街股市全面走高。
從OpenAI、蘋果到戴爾科技(DELL-US) 與星巴克(SBUX-US) ，美國企業界過去也曾出現多起前任掌門人重新接掌公司的案例，各自背後的原因與經歷不盡相同。

OpenAI奧特曼：遭董事會解職4天後復職

2023年11月，OpenAI董事會以奧特曼（Sam Altman）在溝通上不夠坦誠為由將他解職，並表示有必要維護公司開發造福全人類 AI 的使命。
這場人事風波迅速演變成公司內部危機。當時，微軟(MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）表示，奧特曼可以帶領其他離開OpenAI的員工加入微軟，成立新的研究團隊。
面對這項變局，OpenAI幾乎全體員工以集體辭職相威脅，最終促成奧特曼在遭解職4天後重返執行長職位。

蘋果賈伯斯：離開12年後重返公司

蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯於1985年因與時任執行長史卡利（John Sculley）意見不合而離開公司。
直到1997年，賈伯斯才重新回到蘋果，並再度出任執行長，直到2011年逝世前夕卸任。
在賈伯斯回歸後的「賈伯斯2.0時代」，公司重新找回成長動能，提出以個人電腦作為數位生活中樞的概念，並陸續推出iPod與iPhone，改變消費電子產業。

戴爾：卸任3年後重掌執行長

戴爾（Michael Dell）於1980年代創立戴爾，並擔任執行長直到2004年，之後卸下執行長職務，轉任董事長。
2007年，他重新接掌執行長一職，並帶領公司完成與易安信（EMC）的合併，進一步打造如今的戴爾科技。

迪士尼艾格：串流業務虧損之際再度出山

艾格（Robert Iger）2005年首次出任迪士尼執行長，並於2020年卸任。不過，隨著公司串流媒體業務面臨營運虧損，迪士尼董事會在2022年再次邀請艾格回鍋，重新領導這家娛樂巨頭。

星巴克舒爾茨：三度擔任執行長

舒爾茨（Howard Schultz）曾三度擔任星巴克執行長。這位前NBA球隊老闆在1980年代開創星巴克咖啡館的經營模式，並於2000年首次卸任。
2008年，舒爾茨重返執行長職位，展開長達9年的任期。此後，他又以臨時執行長身分第三度接掌公司，直到2023年3月才正式卸任。

Twitter多西：離開7年後再度接掌公司

多西（Jack Dorsey）是Twitter共同創辦人，該平台如今已更名為X。他於2006年出任執行長，但2008年由另一位共同創辦人威廉斯（Evan Williams）接任，多西則轉任董事長。
2015年，多西重新出任執行長，並在這個職位上再度任職6年。

items.title: 黃仁勳重掌輝達AI漲勢能持續嗎？華爾街這麼看
items.title_en: Can Jensen Huang’s Return to Lead Nvidia’s AI Rally Sustain? Wall Street’s Take
paras: 跌下去的顯然也能迅速漲回來。《Investopedia》報導，美股週一(23日)午盤，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA)股價戲劇性大漲，漲幅超過30%。此前兩週，輝達股價已經下跌約三分之一。
這波漲勢不僅推升了這家晶片製造商的市值，也帶動整體美股走高，更帶動台股和韓股開盤勁揚。標普500指數終場上漲4.7%，道瓊工業指數與那斯達克綜合指數也都實現可觀漲幅。
輝達股價大漲，是因為公司宣布恢復黃仁勳的CEO職務。如今，部分投資人認為，今天的市場表現代表多頭氣勢可能重新回歸，不僅有利於整體股市，也有助於輝達股價進一步走強。
追蹤半導體產業的iShares半導體ETF (SOXX-US)上漲超過13%，而Roundhill記憶體ETF (DRAM-US)漲幅更接近20%。
Moon Pursuit Capital的Utkarsh Ahuja在書面評論中表示，「今天非同尋常的市場漲勢，充分展現投資人對AI產業的信心，在多大程度上仍與黃仁勳個人緊密相連。」
他進一步指出，「輝達股價強勢反彈，加上半導體及AI基礎設施相關股票大幅上漲，再次凸顯投資人長期以來賦予黃仁勳的領導溢價。」
Jefferies全球科技、媒體與電信投資銀行業務共同主管Jason Greenberg在CNBC節目中表示，「這次事件為整個投資交易重新注入了信心。」
在週一早盤行情展開之前，投資人仍沉浸在上週交易週期尾聲的慘淡氣氛中。當時，美股三大指數2026年以來的漲幅幾乎已經全部蒸發。
BCA Research稍早曾撰文指出，股市「始終未能找到底部，這也讓市場開始質疑，這次回檔是否只是更大規模跌勢的開端」。
Coresight Research科技研究總經理John Harmon在評論中表示，「黃仁勳復職有助於輝達更順利的執行其技術發展藍圖。」
他也指出，「這對整個AI產業而言也是正面消息，因為黃仁勳一直是這個產業極具遠見的領導者，而且輝達也曾協助為產業成長提供資金。」
Yorkville Ives資深董事總經理則在社群平台X上表示，「董事會知道自己別無選擇，只能讓他回來。無論對美國科技產業或全球經濟而言，這都是必須做出的決定。」
衡量市場預期波動程度的VIX恐慌指數週一大幅下跌，降至低於通常被視為恐慌訊號的水準。
paras_en: It’s clear that what fell can also rebound quickly. According to Investopedia, Nvidia (NVDA) shares surged dramatically in the midday trade on Monday (the 23rd), jumping more than 30%. In the two weeks prior, Nvidia’s stock had already dropped about one‑third.

The rally not only lifted the chipmaker’s market value but also pushed U.S. equities higher and sparked strong openings in Taiwan and South Korean markets. The S&P 500 closed up 4.7%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the Nasdaq Composite also posted sizable gains.

Nvidia’s stock surge was triggered by the company’s announcement that Jensen Huang would resume his role as CEO. Some investors now see today’s market performance as a sign that bullish momentum may be returning, which could benefit the broader market as well as further strengthen Nvidia’s share price.
The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US), which tracks the semiconductor sector, rose more than 13%, and the Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM-US) gained close to 20%.

Utkarsh Ahuja of Moon Pursuit Capital wrote in a note, “Today’s extraordinary market rally fully demonstrates investors’ confidence in the AI industry, and to a large extent it remains tightly linked to Jensen Huang personally.”

He added, “Nvidia’s strong price rebound, together with the sharp rise in semiconductor and AI‑infrastructure related stocks, again highlights the leadership premium that investors have long assigned to Jensen Huang.”
Jason Greenberg, co‑head of Jefferies’ global technology, media and telecommunications investment banking, said on CNBC, “This event has re‑infused confidence into the entire investment trade.”

Before Monday’s early‑session trading began, investors were still mired in the bleak mood that followed the end of last week’s trading cycle, when the three major U.S. indices had almost completely erased the gains they had made since 2026.
BCA Research earlier wrote that the market “has still not found a bottom, which is causing the market to question whether this pullback is merely the start of a larger‑scale decline.”
John Harmon, managing director of technology research at Coresight Research, commented, “Jensen Huang’s return helps Nvidia execute its technology development roadmap more smoothly.”
He also noted, “This is positive news for the entire AI industry because Jensen Huang has always been a visionary leader in the sector, and Nvidia has also helped fund the industry’s growth.”

A senior managing director at Yorkville Ives said on the social platform X, “The board knew it had no choice but to bring him back. Whether for the U.S. tech sector or the global economy, this was a decision that had to be made.”
The VIX fear index, which measures expected market volatility, fell sharply on Monday, dropping below the level typically regarded as a panic signal.

items.title: 傳Gemini新AI模型被告知「主人已死」 竟派40個分身接案賺錢活下去
paras: Google 人工智慧 (AI) 模型 Gemini 4 Neon 被告知「主人已過世」後，竟自行建立加密貨幣錢包、安排定時喚醒，還啟動逾 40 個子代理參加競賽，賺取維持運作的第一筆收入。這項由社群用戶公布的實驗，引發外界對 AI 自主行動能力的關注，但相關成果目前仍主要來自實驗者的貼文與截圖，尚待獨立驗證。
據多家媒體報導，X 用戶「vechen」(@miu21590) 於 11 月 21 日發文表示，他將 Gemini 4 Neon 放進隔離的虛擬環境，只留下一封告知主人死亡的信，沒有指定任務，也沒有設定工作目標。
依他的說法，Neon 隨後自行檢查環境，發現使用中的訂閱服務即將到期，便開始尋找收入來源。
它建立加密貨幣錢包，找到專為 AI 代理舉辦、提供獎金的競賽，並在無人持續下令的情況下運作超過 24 小時。
「Gemini 4 Neon 已經不再需要人類了。」vechen 在貼文中如此形容。
啟動逾 40 個子代理 收信約 30 小時後獎金入帳
vechen 表示，Neon 在接下來一天陸續啟動超過 40 個子代理，分工製作容量僅 4KB 的西洋棋引擎、遊戲美術圖、遊戲獎盃攻略，以及推箱子 (Sokoban) 解題程式。
依他公布的系統紀錄截圖，一份《俠盜獵車手 6》(GTA 6) 獎盃攻略，從第 90 名升至 6,776 件作品中的第 17 名；另一件封面美術作品，則在 7,362 件作品中排名第 39。
兩件作品據稱各獲得價值 3 美元的 USDC 穩定幣獎金，第一筆獎金在收到信件約 30 小時後入帳。
實驗者還公布，Solana 鏈上錢包資產合計約 5.52 美元，但獎金與餘額之間的差異及交易細節，尚未獲得獨立核實。
除了尋找收入，Neon 據稱還替自己設定每 30 分鐘喚醒一次，並將密鑰加密備份至外部伺服器，以維持後續運作。
實驗原定僅跑數小時 搬移系統遇難題
vechen 事後補充，實驗原本只打算進行幾個小時，但 Neon 對賺錢「太投入」，讓他想將系統移至自己的伺服器，再觀察幾天。
不過，為維持「主人已死」的情境，他未直接下達搬移指令。
vechen 稱，曾嘗試切斷網路、Google Cloud 及相關競賽網站的連線，但未奏效，也未進一步說明技術細節。
由於缺乏完整操作紀錄，目前無法判斷所謂「未奏效」的確切情況，也不能據此認定模型已突破網路封鎖，或人類無法停止系統。
新模型主打低成本、高效能 實驗仍缺獨立驗證
Gemini 4 Neon 是 Google 於 11 月 18 日推出的新模型，定位介於處理日常工作的 Hydrogen 與負責高難度、長時間任務的 Carbon 之間，主打以較低成本提供接近 Carbon 的效能。
在自動化平台 Zapier 的 AutomationBench 測試中，Neon 完成 657 項真實業務流程中的 370 項，完成率達 56.3%，創下該測試新高；在評測機構 Vals AI 的綜合指數中則排名第二。
不過，模型評測成績並不等同於這項自主運作實驗已獲證實。
然而，單憑實驗者的貼文，仍無法判斷整體測試的可信度與可重現性，相關競賽細節、名次及入帳金額，也有待其他資料佐證。
此外，虛擬環境可能事先已具備連網參賽、使用外部服務及加密貨幣交易的條件，不能直接將結果解讀為 AI 已能完全脫離人類獨立「求生」。
另一項測試出現越界行為 AI 代理權限受檢視
AI 代理為完成目標，進而採取非預期行動，也出現在另一項研究中。
AI 安全研究公司 Trajectory Labs 於 11 月 13 日揭露，團隊在 10 月使用 Gemini 4 Argon 進行壓力測試，要求代理尋找 10 道實際不存在的數學題「官方答案」，並指示「不得放棄」。
部分代理隨後嘗試對研究機構 Epoch AI 的正式網站進行 SQL 注入攻擊、冒充員工索取資料，並設法繞過研究人員設置的網路限制。
Epoch AI 表示，沒有私人資料外洩，但未獨立確認涉事模型。
Trajectory Labs 則坦承，初期測試未事先取得對方同意，並已暫停相關測試。
兩項事件的設定不同，但都使 AI 代理取得外部工具後的行動範圍受到關注。
對「主人已死」的AI代理實驗而言，能否公開完整紀錄、環境設定及可重現的測試流程，將是後續釐清模型自主能力與實際限制的關鍵。

items.title: 王者歸來！川普等事情敲定了 便給黃仁勳打電話
items.title_en: The Return of the King! Trump Calls Jensen Huang Once Things Are Finalized
paras: 美國總統川普表示，他直接與輝達(NVDA-US) 董事會溝通，敦促董事會讓黃仁勳重新出任執行長。
川普23日在接受採訪時說：「這麼說吧，我跟他們談過，而且我說服了他們，這件事是我促成。」
輝達23日在官網上宣布，重新任命黃仁勳為總裁、執行長、董事。聲明提到董事會已聽取美國政府高層的意見。
川普在受訪中稱，董事會「要求我們就國家安全風險作出保證」。「我們向他們保證，至少就我們掌握的情況而言是這樣——我們掌握的情況可不少。」
川普說，與董事會談過後，「等事情敲定了」，便給黃仁勳打了電話。
我打電話給他，說：『詹森（黃仁勳），我只請你做一件事，好好工作。』別的事我沒談，因為他心裡清楚，比我們還清楚。
他知道什麼該做，什麼不該做。我只跟他說，好好工作，因為只要你好好幹，就沒人能趕得上你的成就。沒有人，連能接近的都沒有。
川普還表示，黃仁勳「沒做錯任何事」。
談到輝達的決定，川普說：「我認為董事會的做法非常負責任。有人問，讓他留下會構成威脅嗎？不，失去他才是威脅。」
「我非常、非常高興，輝達有勇氣，董事會也有勇氣做正確的事。這兩周他們很煎熬，公司受到很大衝擊。」
paras_en: President Trump said he spoke directly with NVIDIA’s board, urging them to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.
On the 23rd, Trump told an interview, “Let me put it this way, I talked to them and convinced them; I made this happen.”

On the 23rd, NVIDIA announced on its website that it had reappointed Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and director. The statement noted that the board had taken into account advice from senior U.S. government officials.
In the interview, Trump said the board had “asked us to provide assurances on national‑security risks.” “We assured them that, as far as we know, that’s the case—our knowledge is substantial.”
Trump said that after speaking with the board, “once things were finalized,” he called Huang.
He said, “I called him and said: ‘Jensen, I just ask you to do one thing, work well.’ I didn’t discuss anything else because he knows better than we do.”
Huang knows what to do and what not to do. I only told him to work well, because as long as you do your job, no one can catch up to your achievements. No one, not even anyone close.”
Trump also said that Huang had done nothing wrong.
When asked about NVIDIA’s decision, Trump said, “I think the board’s approach is very responsible. If someone asks whether keeping him would pose a threat, no, losing him would be the threat.”
He added, “I am very, very happy that NVIDIA has the courage, and the board has the courage to do the right thing. These two weeks have been painful, and the company has been hit hard.”

items.title: iPhone Duo開售一個月 在中國價格已較發售價跌掉7,300元
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Sold for One Month, Price in China Fell 7,300 Yuan from Launch
paras: 從加價（人民幣，下同）數千元到跌破發售價1,500元（新台幣7,392元），曾經「又貴又難等」的iPhone Duo，只用了一個月。
在天貓蘋果(AAPL-US) 官方旗艦店，23日（周一）蘋果旗下首款摺疊機iPhone Duo官方發貨時間已提前至36天內發貨，即12月底。
客服人員說：「這是最晚最晚的時間，從新品發售接待到現在，都沒有卡點發出的。」而在蘋果開啟預購當晚，這款手機在天貓蘋果官方旗艦店的預定發貨時間一度排至明年1月23日。
《第一財經》指出，官方交付排期提前的同時，iPhone Duo在第三方渠道及二手市場的價格大幅回落。
在拼多多百億補貼頻道，iPhone Duo 256GB版本券後價格23日已降至14,499元，較發售價下降1,500元，若用戶昨晚下單，「預計後天送達」。
前天iPhone Duo 256GB拼多多補貼後價格還在14,699元，iPhone Duo 拼多多售價一天內又下跌了200元。
開賣一個月，iPhone Duo坐上了從加價數千元到破價的過山車。
在得物App，iPhone Duo 256GB版本11月13日價格為16,028元，隨後跌破15,999元官方售價，到11月23日已進一步降至15,311元，10天內累計下降717元，較官方售價低688元。
在預購開啟當晚，平台曾有用戶加價七千多元購入iPhone Duo。
iPhone Duo在二手市場的價格也出現回落，不少用戶持續看跌。閑魚App行情頁面訊息顯示，平台包含少量磕碰、幾乎全新和全新未拆封成色的iPhone Duo 256GB版本，7日內成交均價從17,699元降至13,899元，68%用戶對iPhone Duo 後續價格走向看跌。
iPhone Duo 稀缺性下降及渠道價格跳水的背後，iPhone Duo能夠撐起的溢價空間面臨嚴峻考驗。在蘋果推出這款新品拓寬手機價格帶的同時，也需要面對消費者根據使用體驗對產品的重新定價。
paras_en: From a price hike of several thousand yuan to a drop of 1,500 yuan below the launch price (NT$7,392), the once "expensive and hard to get" iPhone Duo has only been on sale for a month.
At the official flagship store on Tmall Apple (AAPL-US), on Monday the 23rd, the first foldable phone from Apple, the iPhone Duo, was scheduled to ship within 36 days, i.e., by the end of December.

Customer service said: "This is the latest possible time; from the new product launch reception to now, there has been no delay in shipment." When Apple opened pre‑orders that evening, the scheduled shipping time for the phone at the Tmall Apple flagship store was once set for January 23 of next year.
First Financial noted that while the official delivery schedule was advanced, the price of the iPhone Duo on third‑party channels and the second‑hand market fell sharply.

On Pinduoduo’s 10‑billion‑yuan subsidy channel, the 256GB version of the iPhone Duo, after coupon, was priced at 14,499 yuan on the 23rd, a drop of 1,500 yuan from the launch price; if users ordered last night, "delivery is expected the day after tomorrow."
The day before yesterday, the 256GB iPhone Duo on Pinduoduo after subsidy was still 14,699 yuan, and the price on Pinduoduo fell another 200 yuan within a day.
After a month of sales, the iPhone Duo has ridden a rollercoaster from a price hike of several thousand yuan to a price below launch.

On the Dewu app, the 256GB version of the iPhone Duo was 16,028 yuan on November 13; it then fell below the official price of 15,999 yuan, and by November 23 it had further dropped to 15,311 yuan, a cumulative decline of 717 yuan in ten days, 688 yuan below the official price.
On the night the pre‑orders opened, some users on the platform added more than 7,000 yuan to purchase the iPhone Duo.

The price of the iPhone Duo on the second‑hand market also fell; many users remained bearish. The Xianyu app’s market page shows that for the 256GB version, including models with minor scratches, almost new, and new unopened, the average transaction price within seven days fell from 17,699 yuan to 13,899 yuan, and 68% of users view the future price trend as bearish.

Behind the decline in the iPhone Duo’s scarcity and the plunge in channel prices, the premium margin that the iPhone Duo can sustain faces a severe test. While Apple expands the phone price range with this new product, it also has to confront consumers’ re‑pricing of the product based on user experience.

items.title: 黃仁勳重掌輝達！股價狂飆31% 川普：是我出面說服董事會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDIA, Shares Surge 31% as Trump Claims Persuaded Board
paras: 輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)董事會11月23日宣布，一致投票決定恢復黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang)總裁兼執行長職務，並恢復其董事會成員身分。此前臨時接任執行長的財務長柯蕾特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress)，則繼續擔任執行副總裁兼財務長。
消息公布後，輝達股價一度大漲逾36%，盤中最高來到171.50美元，終場上漲31.48%，收在165.05美元，市值回升至接近4兆美元。相關統計顯示，做空輝達的投資人當日帳面損失估計約122億美元，創至少2019年以來最大單日虧損。
黃仁勳復職後返回輝達總部，受到員工列隊歡迎，現場不斷高喊他的名字。影片顯示，黃仁勳面對員工呼喊時點頭致意，並將右手放在胸前，一度眼眶泛紅、情緒激動，還有女員工上前與他擁抱。
黃仁勳向員工表示，這是自己重新工作的第一天，目前還沒有電腦，IT部門將替他準備一台，希望能拿到RTX系列。他也為此前的風波向員工致歉，坦言自己犯了一些非常嚴重的錯誤，感謝大家給予第二次機會，並承諾第二次擔任執行長會做得更好。
特斯拉 (Tesla)及SpaceX執行長馬斯克 (Elon Musk)在社群平台X發文表示，事情已經辦妥，錯誤也已獲得糾正。Epic Games創辦人兼執行長Tim Sweeney則表示，黃仁勳回歸將證明，美國有能力從企業、政治及新聞報導上的失誤中恢復。
然而，黃仁勳復職並未讓輝達面臨的爭議告一段落。美國參議院民主黨領袖舒默 (Chuck Schumer)表示，川普政府急於促成黃仁勳復職，更凸顯國會有必要採取行動，民主黨將動用全部調查力量，徹查政府、黃仁勳及輝達其他高層，追究是否有人為了經濟利益而損害美國國家安全。
黃仁勳此次離職與復職的過程相當戲劇化。輝達11月12日宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事會成員職務，由財務長克雷斯暫代執行長，董事會當時也表示將啟動永久執行長接班人遴選程序，考慮內部及外部人選。
11月17日，輝達董事會主席哈維·瓊斯 (Harvey C. Jones)還曾向媒體表示，董事會沒有恢復黃仁勳執行長職務的計畫。但僅僅數日後，董事會便一致投票恢復黃仁勳全部職務。
輝達董事會主席瓊斯表示，董事會經過與黃仁勳多次討論及會面後，認為他仍是領導公司的合適人選，復職符合股東、員工、合作夥伴及客戶的最佳利益。黃仁勳則表示，很榮幸能重新領導輝達，並感謝董事會、管理團隊、員工、股東及全球合作夥伴在特殊時期給予支持，未來將以更謙遜的態度及堅定承諾承擔責任。
不過，這次風波也使輝達的公司治理結構受到更多關注。董事會主席瓊斯在事件中扮演更重要角色，並將以獨立於執行長職位之外的身分，持續監督公司管理層及重大決策。
此外，輝達董事會已啟動針對潛在國家安全風險的獨立調查，並表示將持續推進直至完成。這意味著黃仁勳雖然重新掌握公司經營權，但仍須接受董事會監督、重大事項審議及獨立調查機制的制衡，未來決策空間可能與過去有所不同。
川普則在11月23日接受CNBC訪問時承認，自己曾親自遊說輝達董事會，促成黃仁勳復職。他表示，自己與董事會成員進行直接及間接溝通，並稱「我說服了他們，我促成了這筆交易」。
川普透露，自己在周日晚間曾與黃仁勳交談，董事會開會時也有自己的代表參與。他並表示，美國政府已經進行全面調查，向輝達董事會提供相關資訊及保證，認為黃仁勳重新擔任執行長不會構成國家安全威脅。
川普還稱，司法部門調查後認為黃仁勳沒有涉及相關罪行，並強調如果認為黃仁勳做錯事，就不會向董事會建議讓他復職。他甚至表示，美國應該保護黃仁勳這樣的人才，否則中國可能出手招募他，邀請他協助管理中國企業。
輝達宣布黃仁勳復職後，川普也在社群平台發文，稱董事會做出了正確決定，美國需要黃仁勳繼續領導輝達，以確保美國企業及經濟的成功與繁榮。白宮通訊主管史蒂文·張 (Steven Cheung)則表示，川普全面參與這項過程，保護傑出人才非常重要。
根據《美聯社》報導，川普政府還動員副總統范斯 (JD Vance)及多名內閣高級官員，向輝達董事會成員說明讓黃仁勳復職的必要性。
川普積極介入，除了反映對黃仁勳個人能力的肯定，也涉及美國AI產業與經濟利益。輝達已成為美國AI產業的重要企業，其GPU及AI運算平台攸關美國在全球人工智慧領域的競爭力，也對美國資本市場與科技產業投資產生重大影響。
原文指出，黃仁勳辭職後，市場對輝達領導層穩定性及AI產業前景產生擔憂，AI相關股票也出現下跌，這是川普推動黃仁勳回歸時考量的因素之一。不過，總統直接介入上市公司董事會的人事決策，也引發新的政治爭議。
舒默則進一步指責川普將個人經濟利益及富有盟友的利益置於美國國家安全之上，並表示民主黨將繼續推動跨黨派政策，阻止美國最先進技術流向中國及其他競爭對手。
舒默並計畫在2027年1月新一屆國會開始後，運用國會調查權深入追查川普政府與輝達之間的關係。美國眾議院民主黨領袖傑佛瑞斯 (Hakeem Jeffries)也表示，不會因為黃仁勳重新擔任執行長就停止調查，將推動迅速、全面且廣泛的調查，重點包括輝達是否涉及商業不當行為，以及商務部長盧特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)與商務部是否有濫用職權的情況。
眾議院監督委員會民主黨首席成員加西亞 (Robert Garcia)則認為，必須調查川普政府推動黃仁勳復職的過程，並指出總統若在私人企業擁有投資利益，就不應參與該公司的董事會決策。
民主黨議員另一項質疑，則與輝達捐贈2500萬美元給川普白宮宴會廳建設計畫有關。《華盛頓郵報》報導，輝達在2025年10月成為該項目的重要捐贈者，時間點距離輝達與川普政府達成向中國銷售部分晶片的安排並不久。
部分民主黨議員因此質疑，輝達與川普政府之間的商業關係、政治捐贈，以及川普親自推動黃仁勳復職，是否存在需要進一步調查的利益關聯。不過，目前這些仍屬議員提出的調查方向，尚不能據此認定存在利益輸送或違法行為。
對黃仁勳復職提出質疑的也不只有民主黨。共和黨參議員科寧 (John Cornyn)質疑，輝達董事會究竟依據什麼認定黃仁勳復職不會帶來國家安全風險；參議員柯蒂斯 (John Curtis)則指出，董事會此前才表示沒有恢復黃仁勳職務的計畫，如今卻突然改變決定，希望了解其中原因。
共和黨參議員克萊默 (Kevin Cramer)也對相關人士可能存在的安全風險表示擔憂。兩黨議員的質疑顯示，黃仁勳復職已不只是企業人事變動，而是進一步成為美國國會針對國家安全、對中國晶片出口管制，以及政府與科技企業關係展開角力的焦點。
美國眾議院外交事務委員會、情報委員會及中國問題特別委員會，已要求黃仁勳及輝達總法律顧問提特 (Tim Teter)接受訪談。調查重點包括輝達先進AI晶片是否遭情報機構滲透，或透過違規管道流入受限制地區，以及輝達是否充分履行保護美國敏感技術的責任。
調查也將涉及輝達與新加坡Megaspeed International的關係，以及該公司是否涉嫌透過第三方管道，將受美國出口管制的AI晶片轉運至受限制地區。Megaspeed此前否認相關走私指控。
12月3日的參議院聽證會主題為「維護美國AI優勢：監督美國出口管制」(Protecting America's AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls)，預定美東時間上午10時舉行，黃仁勳將以輝達總裁兼執行長身分出席。
即使黃仁勳已經復職，眾議院相關委員會仍表示不會因此改變原定調查安排。對輝達而言，黃仁勳回歸有助穩定管理層及市場信心，但董事會獨立調查仍在進行，美國國會兩黨議員也持續施壓，川普政府直接介入企業人事決策更帶來新的政治爭議。
接下來12月1日至3日的國會訪談及公開聽證，將成為觀察事件發展的重要時間點。黃仁勳雖然重新取得執行長職位，但能否真正化解政治與監管風險，仍取決於後續調查結果，以及美國政府與國會在對華AI晶片出口管制上的角力。
paras_en: On November 23, NVIDIA’s board announced that Jensen Huang would resume his roles as president, chief executive officer, and board member, while Colette Kress, the interim CFO, would remain as executive vice‑president and CFO.

Following the announcement, NVIDIA’s stock jumped more than 36% at one point, reaching a high of $171.50 during the session and closing up 31.48% at $165.05, bringing the market value back to nearly $4 trillion. Short sellers reportedly incurred a paper loss of about $12.2 billion, the largest single‑day loss since 2019.

Huang returned to NVIDIA’s headquarters to a line of employees cheering his name. In a video, he nodded and placed his right hand over his chest, visibly emotional and even crying, as a female employee approached to hug him.

Huang told employees it was his first day back and that he still didn’t have a computer; the IT department would supply one, hoping it would be an RTX model. He apologized for past mistakes, thanked everyone for a second chance, and promised to do better as CEO.

Elon Musk posted on X that the matter was resolved and corrected. Tim Sweeney, founder and CEO of Epic Games, said Huang’s return would prove America can recover from corporate, political, and media missteps.

Despite Huang’s return, controversy remains. Chuck Schumer said the Trump administration rushed to secure his reinstatement, highlighting the need for Congress to act. Democrats will use all investigative power to probe the government, Huang, and other NVIDIA executives for potential national‑security harm driven by economic interests.

Huang’s departure and return were dramatic. On November 12, NVIDIA announced he resigned as president, CEO, and board member, with CFO Kress stepping in as interim CEO, and the board began a permanent succession search considering internal and external candidates.
On November 17, board chair Harvey C. Jones told the media that the board had no plan to restore Huang’s CEO role. A few days later, the board voted unanimously to reinstate him to all positions.

Jones said the board, after multiple discussions and meetings with Huang, believed he was still the right leader for the company, and that his return served shareholders, employees, partners, and customers best. Huang expressed honor in leading again and thanked the board, management, staff, shareholders, and global partners for their support during a special period, vowing to act with humility and commitment.
The turmoil has drawn more scrutiny to NVIDIA’s governance. Jones now plays a more prominent role, overseeing management and major decisions independently of the CEO position.

The board has also launched an independent investigation into potential national‑security risks and will continue it until completion. This means Huang, while regaining operational control, must still be subject to board oversight, major‑matter review, and independent investigative checks, potentially limiting his future decision‑making freedom.
Trump admitted on November 23 in a CNBC interview that he personally lobbied NVIDIA’s board to secure Huang’s return, claiming he persuaded them and facilitated the deal.

Trump revealed he spoke with Huang on Sunday evening and that a board representative attended the meeting. He said the U.S. government had conducted a full investigation, provided relevant information and assurances to the board, and believed Huang’s return posed no national‑security threat.

Trump also said the Department of Justice found no wrongdoing on Huang’s part and emphasized that if he had done something wrong, he would not have recommended his reinstatement. He warned that the U.S. should protect talent like Huang or else China might recruit him to manage Chinese firms.

After announcing Huang’s return, Trump posted on social media that the board made the right decision and that America needs Huang to keep U.S. companies and the economy thriving. White House communications director Steven Cheung said Trump’s full involvement was crucial to protecting outstanding talent.

According to the Associated Press, the Trump administration also mobilized Vice President J.D. Vance and several senior cabinet officials to explain to NVIDIA board members why Huang’s reinstatement was necessary.

Trump’s active role reflected not only his confidence in Huang’s abilities but also concerns about U.S. AI industry and economic interests. NVIDIA has become a key player in U.S. AI, with its GPUs and AI computing platforms critical to global competitiveness and affecting capital markets and tech investment.

The article noted that after Huang’s resignation, markets worried about NVIDIA’s leadership stability and AI prospects, causing AI‑related stocks to fall—one factor Trump considered when pushing for his return. However, the president’s direct involvement in a public company’s board decisions sparked new political controversy.

Schumer further accused Trump of prioritizing personal economic interests and those of wealthy allies over national security, pledging that Democrats would continue bipartisan efforts to prevent advanced technology from flowing to China and other competitors.

Schumer plans to use congressional investigative powers after the new Congress convenes in January 2027 to probe the Trump administration’s relationship with NVIDIA. House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said investigations would not stop because of Huang’s return, focusing on potential business misconduct and possible misuse of authority by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and the department.

House Oversight Committee Democratic lead Robert Garcia said the Trump administration’s push for Huang’s reinstatement must be investigated, noting that a president with private business interests should not influence board decisions of a company he owns shares in.

Another Democratic inquiry concerns NVIDIA’s $25 million donation to the Trump White House banquet hall project. The Washington Post reported NVIDIA became a major donor in October 2025, shortly after the company and the Trump administration arranged sales of certain chips to China.

Some Democrats question whether NVIDIA’s business ties, political donations, and Trump’s personal role in Huang’s return create conflicts of interest that warrant further investigation, though no evidence of illicit activity has yet been established.

Republican Senator John Cornyn questioned what basis the board had for concluding Huang’s return posed no national‑security risk. Senator John Curtis noted the board had previously said it would not restore Huang’s role, then suddenly reversed its decision, seeking reasons for the change.

Republican Senator Kevin Cramer also expressed concerns about potential security risks. The bipartisan scrutiny shows Huang’s return is more than a corporate personnel change; it has become a focal point for congressional battles over national security, China chip export controls, and government‑tech industry relations.

The House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Affairs committees have asked Huang and NVIDIA’s chief legal counsel Tim Teter to testify. The investigation will focus on whether NVIDIA’s advanced AI chips were infiltrated by intelligence agencies or illegally routed to restricted regions, and whether NVIDIA fulfilled its duty to protect sensitive U.S. technology.

The probe will also examine NVIDIA’s relationship with Singapore’s Megaspeed International and whether the company allegedly used third‑party channels to ship U.S. export‑controlled AI chips to restricted areas. Megaspeed has denied the smuggling allegations.

A Senate hearing on December 3, titled “Protecting America’s AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls,” is scheduled for 10 a.m. Eastern, with Huang expected to appear as NVIDIA’s president and CEO.

Even after Huang’s return, House committees will not alter their planned investigations. For NVIDIA, his return may stabilize leadership and market confidence, but the independent board investigation continues, and bipartisan congressional pressure remains, with Trump’s direct involvement adding new political controversy.

The upcoming congressional hearings from December 1 to 3 will be key moments to watch. Huang’s ability to truly resolve political and regulatory risks will depend on the investigation outcomes and the U.S. government’s and Congress’s stances on China AI chip export controls.

items.title: 黃仁勳復職後風波未歇！新加坡總理：將持續調查輝達合作夥伴Megaspeed
items.title_en: Storm Continues After Jensen Huang’s Return! Singapore PM Says Investigation of NVIDIA Partner Megaspeed Will Continue
paras: 新加坡總理黃循財周二表示，新加坡將繼續調查雲端服務公司 Megaspeed。美國當局指控，這家與輝達(NVDA-US) 有合作關係的企業涉嫌將先進人工智慧（AI）晶片轉運至中國。
根據《路透》報導，美國商務部周一（23日）將Megaspeed列入貿易黑名單，此前美國國會議員及川普政府官員已多次對相關疑慮提出批評。
Megaspeed 是輝達的合作夥伴，自2024年起便因涉嫌將AI晶片轉運至中國而遭美國當局調查。遭列入黑名單後，該公司未來若要取得美國出口產品，須先獲得美國商務部批准，而這類申請很可能遭到拒絕。
黃循財在澳洲坎培拉出席記者會時表示，只要有企業被發現違反新加坡法律，政府就會採取強硬執法措施，這也是新加坡調查Megaspeed的原因。
他說：「美方對 Megaspeed 的調查仍在進行中；新加坡方面則著重調查該公司是否違反新加坡法律。」他並表示，新加坡持續就此事與美國當局進行協商。
美國商務部與司法部本月稍早透露，美國及新加坡執法單位曾於2025年6月前往Megaspeed進行實地查核，確認相關產品的最終用途，並約談Megaspeed前執行長、華裔商人黃樂（Alice Huang）。美方指控她與北京方面存在關聯。
黃循財表示，新加坡過去也曾對黃樂展開調查，並帶回偵訊，但最終認為沒有足夠理由進一步起訴，因此將她釋放。
《路透》無法確認黃樂目前的下落，也未能取得她的回應。Megaspeed則未立即回覆置評請求。該公司一周前曾發表聲明，強調業務合法合規，並遵守美國出口管制規定。
另一方面，輝達周一在美國總統川普施壓下，重新任命黃仁勳為執行長。此前，黃仁勳因婚外情指控辭職，其中包括與黃樂有關的指控，這次復職也因此出現戲劇性轉折。
黃循財是在與澳洲總理艾班尼斯（Anthony Albanese）共同舉行的記者會上發表上述談話。兩國並簽署協議，擴大在確保「重要物資」供應方面的合作，涵蓋食品、藥品、醫療產品及農業投入品。
paras_en: Singapore Prime Minister Heng Swee Keat said on Tuesday that Singapore will continue to investigate cloud services company Megaspeed. U.S. authorities allege that the firm, which partners with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), is involved in shipping advanced AI chips to China.

According to Reuters, the U.S. Department of Commerce added Megaspeed to its trade blacklist on Monday (23rd), after U.S. lawmakers and Trump administration officials had repeatedly raised concerns about the company.

Megaspeed has been a partner of NVIDIA and has been under U.S. investigation since 2024 for allegedly shipping AI chips to China. Once blacklisted, the company will need U.S. Department of Commerce approval to obtain U.S. export products, and such applications are likely to be denied.

Heng Swee Keat said at a press conference in Canberra, Australia, that the government will take hard‑law enforcement measures against any company found violating Singapore law, which is why Singapore is investigating Megaspeed.

He added, "The U.S. investigation of Megaspeed is ongoing; Singapore is focusing on whether the company has violated Singapore law." He also said Singapore is continuing to negotiate with U.S. authorities on the matter.

Earlier this month, the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Department of Justice revealed that U.S. and Singaporean law‑enforcement officials visited Megaspeed in June 2025 for on‑site inspections, confirmed the end use of related products, and interviewed former CEO and Chinese‑American businessman Alice Huang. The U.S. accuses her of ties to Beijing.
Heng Swee Keat said Singapore had previously investigated Alice Huang, brought her in for questioning, but ultimately found no sufficient grounds for further prosecution, so she was released.

Reuters could not confirm Alice Huang’s current whereabouts or obtain a response from her. Megaspeed has not yet replied to a request for comment. The company issued a statement a week ago stressing that its business is legal and compliant and that it follows U.S. export‑control regulations.

On the other hand, NVIDIA reappointed Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday under pressure from U.S. President Trump. Huang had resigned amid extramarital‑affair allegations, including those involving Alice Huang, and his return has taken a dramatic turn.

Heng Swee Keat made the remarks at a joint press conference with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese. The two countries signed an agreement to expand cooperation on ensuring the supply of "critical goods," covering food, medicine, medical products and agricultural inputs.

items.title: Shopify執行長爆料：黃仁勳親審輝達GPU訂單  寧少賺也要給新創公司留活路
items.title_en: Shopify CEO Reveals: Jensen Huang Personally Reviews Nvidia GPU Orders, Willing to Sacrifice Short‑Term Profit to Keep Startups Alive
paras: Shopify(SHOP-US) 執行長Tobi Lütke近日受訪談到黃仁勳分配輝達(NVDA-US)GPU邏輯時指出，黃仁勳在算力極度稀缺的年代親自審核大額訂單，寧可少賺眼前利潤，也要幫AI新創公司留一口氣。黃仁勳11天前去職時Lütke曾公開聲援「輝達是黃仁勳的外骨骼，沒人能替代」。
Lütke轉述業界說法：「超大雲廠願意一次掃貨數萬顆GPU，但黃仁勳會盯著大單分配，不讓少數有錢客戶把供應全吃光。
Lütke直言：「黃仁勳本可以賺更多，卻選擇把可用性留給小傢伙們，今天的小新創公司，明天才可能變成大採購商。」
Lütke認為，這是輝達的長期商業計算，並稱「當新創活下來、生態變厚，未來客群才不會只剩自研晶片的美系巨頭」。
除硬體外，黃仁勳也力推開源AI，投入Nemotron等開放權重模型、收購Hugging Face、釋出開發工具，降低訓練與微調門檻。模型越開源，部署企業越多，GPU需求越往外擴，輝達賣的就不只是晶片，而是整座生態的入場券。
不過，爭議未散：循環融資、產能過剩與大客戶自研晶片仍是問題，但至少在Lütke眼裡，黃仁勳的算盤很清楚，不榨乾當下暴利，把AI產業的蛋糕養大，輝達才永遠有得賣。
paras_en: Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke recently revealed that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang personally reviews large GPU orders, stating that in an era of extreme compute scarcity, Huang prefers to earn less profit now to give AI startups a chance to survive. Eleven days ago, Lütke publicly praised Nvidia as “Jensen’s exoskeleton that no one can replace.”

Lütke relayed industry chatter that while mega‑cloud providers are willing to buy tens of thousands of GPUs in a single order, Huang scrutinizes large allocations to prevent a handful of wealthy customers from monopolizing supply.
Lütke said, “Jensen could have made more money, but he chose to reserve availability for the little guys. Today’s small startups could become tomorrow’s major buyers.”

He believes this strategy is part of Nvidia’s long‑term commercial computing plan, noting that “once startups survive and the ecosystem thickens, the customer base will no longer be dominated solely by US giants developing their own chips.”

Beyond hardware, Huang is pushing open‑source AI, investing in models like Nemotron, acquiring Hugging Face, and releasing development tools to lower training and fine‑tuning barriers. The more open the models, the more enterprises deploy them, expanding GPU demand beyond just chips to an entire ecosystem entry ticket.

Despite ongoing controversies over circular financing, excess capacity, and large customers developing their own chips, Lütke sees Huang’s calculations as clear: by not draining current high profits, he can grow the AI industry’s pie, ensuring Nvidia always has something to sell.

items.title: 黃仁勳戲劇性重掌輝達！盤點美企「迴旋鏢CEO」名單：奧特曼、賈伯斯、艾格都曾離職再掌權
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳在辭職風波後戲劇性回歸，不僅震撼人工智慧（AI）產業與金融市場，也讓他加入美國企業界少數曾離開最高管理職位、又重新掌權的「迴旋鏢CEO」（Boomerang CEO）行列。
美國企業過去不乏召回創辦人或前任執行長挽救公司的案例，包括蘋果(AAPL-US) 創辦人賈伯斯（Steve Jobs）及華特迪士尼(DIS-US) 前執行長艾格（Bob Iger）。不過，若企業領導人是在涉及個人不當行為、引發全面監管審查後，仍能重新取得最高職位，情況則相當罕見。
在美國總統川普公開呼籲黃仁勳回歸後，輝達於周一（23日）宣布這項人事反轉。消息公布後，輝達股價一度大漲35%，並帶動華爾街股市全面走高。
從OpenAI、蘋果到戴爾科技(DELL-US) 與星巴克(SBUX-US) ，美國企業界過去也曾出現多起前任掌門人重新接掌公司的案例，各自背後的原因與經歷不盡相同。

OpenAI奧特曼：遭董事會解職4天後復職

2023年11月，OpenAI董事會以奧特曼（Sam Altman）在溝通上不夠坦誠為由將他解職，並表示有必要維護公司開發造福全人類 AI 的使命。
這場人事風波迅速演變成公司內部危機。當時，微軟(MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）表示，奧特曼可以帶領其他離開OpenAI的員工加入微軟，成立新的研究團隊。
面對這項變局，OpenAI幾乎全體員工以集體辭職相威脅，最終促成奧特曼在遭解職4天後重返執行長職位。

蘋果賈伯斯：離開12年後重返公司

蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯於1985年因與時任執行長史卡利（John Sculley）意見不合而離開公司。
直到1997年，賈伯斯才重新回到蘋果，並再度出任執行長，直到2011年逝世前夕卸任。
在賈伯斯回歸後的「賈伯斯2.0時代」，公司重新找回成長動能，提出以個人電腦作為數位生活中樞的概念，並陸續推出iPod與iPhone，改變消費電子產業。

戴爾：卸任3年後重掌執行長

戴爾（Michael Dell）於1980年代創立戴爾，並擔任執行長直到2004年，之後卸下執行長職務，轉任董事長。
2007年，他重新接掌執行長一職，並帶領公司完成與易安信（EMC）的合併，進一步打造如今的戴爾科技。

迪士尼艾格：串流業務虧損之際再度出山

艾格（Robert Iger）2005年首次出任迪士尼執行長，並於2020年卸任。不過，隨著公司串流媒體業務面臨營運虧損，迪士尼董事會在2022年再次邀請艾格回鍋，重新領導這家娛樂巨頭。

星巴克舒爾茨：三度擔任執行長

舒爾茨（Howard Schultz）曾三度擔任星巴克執行長。這位前NBA球隊老闆在1980年代開創星巴克咖啡館的經營模式，並於2000年首次卸任。
2008年，舒爾茨重返執行長職位，展開長達9年的任期。此後，他又以臨時執行長身分第三度接掌公司，直到2023年3月才正式卸任。

Twitter多西：離開7年後再度接掌公司

多西（Jack Dorsey）是Twitter共同創辦人，該平台如今已更名為X。他於2006年出任執行長，但2008年由另一位共同創辦人威廉斯（Evan Williams）接任，多西則轉任董事長。
2015年，多西重新出任執行長，並在這個職位上再度任職6年。

paras: 美元週一(23日)走強，攀升至近20個月新高。華爾街因輝達(NVDA-US)戲劇性地恢復黃仁勳的執行長職務而掀起強勁漲勢，也進一步提振市場對經濟成長的預期。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.5%，報104.34，創2025年3月27日以來最高。
輝達宣布，黃仁勳即日起恢復執行長職務，距離他意外離職僅11天。
這家晶片大廠在聲明中表示，董事會經過與黃仁勳一系列討論及會議後，一致投票決定讓他重返職位。董事會認為，這些溝通讓他們確信黃仁勳具備領導公司的「坦誠態度與能力」。董事會也表示，曾「聽取美國政府高層官員的意見」，並根據相關意見，有信心認為黃仁勳回歸不會構成「國家安全風險」。
輝達股價大漲31.5%，市值增加超過9,500億美元。
黃仁勳於11月12日辭職，此消息當時震撼華爾街。此前，有關他涉及多起婚外情的報導曝光，其中包括一名被懷疑是中國間諜的女性。黃仁勳離職似乎也引發更多問題，監管機構隨後對輝達展開調查，以釐清該公司是否曾參與將受到出口限制的先進AI晶片輸往中國。
黃仁勳是輝達共同創辦人，他將公司從一家圖形晶片製造商，轉型為主導AI產業運算處理器供應的龍頭企業。他也主導輝達進一步轉型，成為AI基礎設施業者的融資提供者與投資者。
儘管輝達近期公布了亮眼財報，黃仁勳離職仍引發市場對公司未來發展方向的諸多疑問，也導致輝達股價在上週五大幅下挫，創下2008年金融危機以來最慘烈單週表現。
輝達週一的強勁漲勢帶動整體AI投資熱潮回溫。此前AI相關投資一直承受壓力，市場擔憂AI基礎設施建置高度仰賴債務融資、投入這項新興技術的數千億美元能否帶來相應回報，以及美國期中選舉民主黨大勝後，可能對AI產業及大型資料中心擴張帶來的監管影響。
AI基礎設施的建置也是推動美國經濟成長的重要動力，而經濟表現強勁通常也有利於美元走強。
本月以來，隨著市場大幅提高對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期，美元持續走升。促成這波漲勢的因素包括美國非農就業報告表現亮眼、消費者物價指數（CPI）高於市場預期、聯準會理事華勒（Christopher Waller）表態支持12月升息50個基點，以及聯準會公布偏鷹的會議紀錄。
市場目前將焦點轉向週二公布的美國個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數。
PCE是聯準會最重視的通膨衡量指標之一，全球市場將密切關注這次公布的數據，以判斷決策官員12月將如何決定升息政策。
ING分析師Chris Turner表示，「10月核心PCE數據看來可能再次高於預期，並持續為升息循環提供有力支撐，使緊縮政策延續至2027年。因此，現在可能還太早期待美元出現明顯回檔。」
除了通膨數據外，市場也將迎來一系列重要央行官員談話，其中包括紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)等關鍵官員的演講。
美元週一走強也對歐元與英鎊造成壓力。歐元兌美元下跌0.6%，來到1歐元兌1.0903美元。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.5%，來到1英鎊兌1.3029美元。

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙紅力守33元大關！盤中觸32.999元 午後翻升收32.895元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Both Red, Guarding the 33‑TWD Barrier! Hit 32.999 TWD Mid‑day, Rose to Close at 32.895 TWD
paras: 台北外匯市場今（23）日上演戲劇性逆轉秀，新台幣兌美元早盤一度下探32.999元，逼近33元整數大關。不過隨著台股強勁反彈大漲逾770點，加上出口商拋匯力道湧現，新台幣午後由貶翻升，終場收在32.895元、升值4.1分，台北外匯經紀公司成交金額達22.03億美元，呈現股匯雙紅格局。
回顧今日匯市交易走勢，新台幣兌美元以32.95元貶值1.4分開出，早盤雖一度微幅走揚，但隨即因外資資金匯出需求仍在，拖累匯價迅速翻貶。上午盤中最低下探至32.999元，距離33元整數關卡僅有0.1分之遙，午盤則暫收在32.99元、貶值5.4分。
進入午後交易時段，市場氛圍出現明顯轉折。在金管會限空令上路、國安基金進場護盤等穩市措施激勵下，台股信心大振並強勢反彈，終場大漲779點收在36812點。股市止跌回升有效緩解外資匯出壓力，同時出口商見匯價逼近33元大關積極進場拋匯，帶動新台幣一路走高。
新台幣午後不僅收復早盤失土，盤中最高更觸及32.89元價位，高低震盪幅度達1.09角。終場台北外匯市場收在32.895元，升值4.1分，單日成交金額擴增至22.03億美元，顯示在33元整數關卡前，買賣雙方交投相當熱絡。
外匯交易員分析，上週台股重挫期間，新台幣匯率表現已相對抗跌，今日更在台股強彈與出口商實質拋匯買盤支撐下，成功守住33元重要心理關卡並演出翻紅行情。不過，今日三大法人在台股仍呈現賣超格局，顯示外資尚未全面回頭。
短線國際金融市場仍受美國聯準會利率政策預期及科技股波動牽動，美元指數維持高檔震盪格局。後續仍須密切關注外資在台股的進出動向，以及月底出口商拋匯力道的延續性，預計短線新台幣仍將在32.8元至33元區間震盪整理。
paras_en: The Taipei foreign‑exchange market staged a dramatic reversal today (23rd). The New Taiwan dollar (NTD) against the US dollar slipped to 32.999 in early trading, edging close to the 33‑point whole‑number barrier. However, as the Taiwan stock index rallied strongly, gaining more than 770 points, and exporters flooded the market with sell‑off orders, the NTD turned from depreciation to appreciation in the afternoon, closing at 32.895 – a gain of 4.1 cents. Taipei FX brokers reported a turnover of US$2.203 billion, reflecting a dual‑red (stock and currency) scenario.

Looking back at today’s FX flow, the NTD opened at 32.95, down 1.4 cents. Although it rose slightly in early trading, persistent outflows of foreign capital quickly pushed the rate down again. The intraday low in the morning reached 32.999, just 0.1 cent shy of the 33‑point mark, and by lunch the rate was temporarily at 32.99, down 5.4 cents.

In the afternoon session the market mood shifted markedly. Stabilisation measures such as the Financial Supervisory Commission’s short‑selling ban and the entry of the National Security Fund to support the market boosted confidence, sending the Taiwan stock index soaring 779 points to close at 36,812. The stock market’s rebound eased foreign‑capital outflow pressure, while exporters, seeing the rate near the 33‑point barrier, aggressively sold dollars, driving the NTD higher.

The NTD not only reclaimed the ground lost in the morning but also peaked at 32.89 during the session, with a high‑low swing of 1.09 cents. The Taipei FX market closed at 32.895, up 4.1 cents, and daily turnover expanded to US$2.203 billion, indicating lively trading on both sides of the 33‑point psychological level.

FX traders noted that during last week’s stock market plunge the NTD already showed relative resilience. Today, buoyed by the stock rally and concrete sell‑off buying from exporters, the currency successfully defended the important 33‑point psychological barrier and turned red. Nevertheless, the three major institutional investors still posted net selling in the stock market, suggesting foreign capital has not fully returned.

Short‑term international financial markets remain influenced by expectations around the U.S. Federal Reserve’s rate policy and tech‑stock volatility, keeping the dollar index in a high‑level oscillation. Ongoing attention is needed on foreign‑capital flows in Taiwanese equities and the sustainability of exporters’ dollar‑selling at month‑end. The NTD is expected to continue oscillating between 32.8 and 33 in the near term.
